source.title: Martin Fronescu wins U.R.A. Spring of Colors 2018, in Bucharest, Romania
source.content: [Martin Fronescu](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/persons/2013FRON01) won the [U.R.A. Spring of Colors 2018](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/URASpringofColors2018) with an average of 8.68 seconds. [Sorin Turculeț](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/persons/2017TURC02) finished second (10.53) and [János Bereczki](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/persons/2018BERE01) finished third (10.78).

translation.title: Martin Fronescu 夺得罗马尼亚布加勒斯特 U.R.A. Spring of Colors 2018 冠军
translation.content: [Martin Fronescu](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/persons/2013FRON01) 以 8.68 秒的平均成绩夺得 [U.R.A. Spring of Colors 2018](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/URASpringofColors2018) 冠军。[Sorin Turculeț](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/persons/2017TURC02) 以 10.53 秒获得亚军，[János Bereczki](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/persons/2018BERE01) 以 10.78 秒获得季军。
